title: Failure and recovery checklist
summary: Six deliberate failures, each of which must produce a clear message and a way to recover rather than a silent or fabricated result.
expected_behaviour: Every case shows a structured error or status with a recovery hint; the application stays usable.
acceptance_checks: Each step below shows the stated outcome.

steps.title: Invalid gas mixture
steps.do: Change the N2 fraction so that the sum is not 1 and press Evaluate.
steps.expect: Error "mixture_not_normalized" with the field name; the explicit Normalize button repairs it. Nothing is normalized silently.

steps.title: Exhausted propellant
steps.do: Choose "Custom free-flight state", set the prograde burn to 4000 m/s and run.
steps.expect: The burn phase ends with outcome "depletion" and a warning that the vehicle cannot deliver the manoeuvre; delivered delta-v equals the vehicle capability.

steps.title: Unsupported chemistry
steps.do: Add carbon monoxide (CO) to the atmosphere and run the 2-D transient solver.
steps.expect: Structured rejection: the Level 3 solver supports only its listed species; choose a Level 1/2 mode or remove the species.

steps.title: Canceled CFD job
steps.do: Start a 2-D transient run with a 96 x 48 grid and press Cancel.
steps.expect: Status becomes "canceled"; no result is shown as if it were complete.

steps.title: Unavailable ephemerides
steps.do: Choose the lunar transfer and set the epoch to 2040-01-01T00:00:00Z.
steps.expect: Error "ephemeris_range": outside the cached interval, no extrapolation; choose an epoch from 2026 to 2031.

steps.title: Lost WebGL context
steps.do: Run any flight, then press "2-D view" (or use a browser with WebGL disabled).
steps.expect: The trajectory and telemetry remain available as a 2-D projection.
